Motivation: 无人机多光谱点云在亚冠层目标检测中受植被阴影引起的严重光照异质性影响，现有方法依赖飞行元数据且难以区分暗目标与真实阴影，亟需一种无需先验信息、能稳健处理光照变化的异常检测方案。

Method: 1) 将太阳角估计建模为逆优化问题，耦合光谱指数与光线追踪模型，实现无先验阴影提取；2) 引入光照一致性稀疏表示机制，从相同光照状态的邻域构建背景字典，解耦光谱反射率与光照变化。 

Result: 该方法在复杂森林环境中显著提升了异常与背景的可分离性，性能优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 该框架适用于识别伪装军事目标、测绘倒木树干以及探测茂密植被下隐藏的考古遗迹等任务。

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) multispectral point clouds (MPC) provide high-dimensional spatial-spectral data for sub-canopy target detection; however, their efficacy is significantly compromised by severe illumination heterogeneity caused by vegetation shadows. To address this, we propose a prior-free anomaly detection framework capable of robustly handling lighting variations. First, we formulate solar angle estimation as an inverse optimization problem. By coupling spectral indices with a ray-tracing model, this strategy achieves Prior-Free Shadow Extraction without relying on flight metadata, effectively distinguishing dark objects from true shadows. Second, to mitigate spectral distortions, we introduce an Illumination-Consistent Sparse Representation mechanism. Unlike standard reconstruction methods, we construct a background dictionary strictly from neighbors sharing the same illumination state. This constraint effectively disentangles spectral reflectance from lighting variations, ensuring that targets are represented solely by physically consistent background points. Experimental results indicate that the proposed method significantly improves the separability between anomalies and background in complex forest environments, demonstrating superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines. This framework is particularly suited for identifying camouflaged military targets, mapping fallen tree trunks, and uncovering archaeological ruins hidden beneath dense foliage.

</details>


### [150] [An Enhanced Geometric-Spectral Feature Learning Framework for Airborne Multispectral Point Cloud Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09123)
*Xian Li,Yanfeng Gu,Aleksandra Pižurica*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于注意力的增强几何-光谱特征学习框架（GSFF），用于机载多光谱点云（MPC）的地物覆盖分类。该框架包括双流特征融合（位置编码全局光谱特征+多核点卷积光谱引导几何特征）、残差注意力融合模块以及联合损失函数，有效解决了MPC的高维异构、样本不平衡和类间光谱相似问题，在两个机载MPC数据集上取得了优于现有方法的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MPC分类模型受限于高维异构的空间-光谱信息、不平衡的样本分布以及机载MPC的类间光谱相似性，导致模型表征能力不足。

Method: 1）双流特征融合方法：第一流使用融合自注意力提取位置编码的全局光谱特征；第二流使用多核点卷积和特征聚合注意力提取光谱引导的几何特征。2）残差注意力融合模块集成最具信息量的几何-光谱特征。3）联合损失函数提高在样本不平衡和类间相似样本上的学习能力。

Result: 在两个机载MPC数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法优于当前最先进的方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的增强几何-光谱特征学习框架有效提升了MPC地物覆盖分类性能，代码和数据集将公开。

Abstract: Multispectral point cloud (MPC) is composed of 3D spatial-spectral information, which holds tremendous potential for accurate land-cover classification. However, the representation power of classification models is limited by inherent high-dimensional and heterogeneous spatial-spectral information, unbalanced sample distribution, and inter-class spectral similarity of airborne MPCs. We build two MPC datasets and propose an enhanced geometric-spectral feature learning framework based on attentions for airborne MPC classification. A key component in our model is a two-stream feature fusion method with attention mechanisms, which enhances the representation capability of spatial-spectral features from high-dimensional heterogeneous MPCs. The first stream aims to extract position-encoded global spectral features with fusion self-attention, and the second stream comprises a multikernel point convolution and feature aggregation attention to extract spectral-guided geometric features. We then develop a residual attention fusion block to integrate the most informative geometric-spectral features from the two parallel streams. Another important contribution of this work is a joint loss function to improve the learning ability on unbalanced and interclass similar samples. Experimental results on two airborne MPC datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with the state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, the codes and datasets used in this paper will be made available freely at https://github.com/HITlixian/TGRS_GSFF.

</details>


### [151] [A Geometric Framework for Absolute Pose and Velocity Estimation with Event Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09139)
*Zibin Liu,Shunkun Liang,Banglei Guan,Yang Shang,Qifeng Yu,Ji Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机和3D线特征同时估计绝对位姿与速度的几何框架，通过线-事件平面正交约束和事件-线投影共线约束，设计了线性与多项式求解器，仅需三条事件-线对应即可独立恢复6自由度位姿或速度，在仿真和真实数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件相机运动估计方法主要关注速度估计，而绝对位姿估计在机器人导航和增强现实中同样关键却研究不足，同时恢复绝对位姿和速度仍是一个开放且具有挑战性的问题。

Method: 提出基于3D线特征与触发事件的几何框架，核心是两个几何约束：3D线与其对应事件平面法向量之间的正交性，以及事件与其关联线2D投影之间的共线性。基于这些约束，设计了用于绝对位姿估计的线性求解器（高效计算）和多项式求解器（全局最优旋转），以及用于速度估计的线性求解器和优化求解器。方法最少需要三条事件-线对应。

Result: 在仿真和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在精度和计算效率上均显著优于现有方法，达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 本文成功解决了事件流中同时恢复绝对位姿和速度的难题，提出的几何框架利用3D线特征实现了高效且精确的6自由度运动估计，demo代码已公开。

Abstract: Despite the rapid advancements in event-based motion estimation, current geometric methods primarily focus on velocity estimation. However, absolute pose estimation, which is equally crucial for key applications such as robotic navigation and augmented reality, remains relatively underexplored. Consequently, the simultaneous recovery of absolute pose and velocity from event streams remains an open and challenging problem. To address this gap, we propose a geometric framework for absolute pose and velocity estimation by leveraging 3D lines in the scene and the events they trigger. At the core of the framework lie two key geometric constraints: the orthogonality between a 3D line and the normal vector of its corresponding event plane, and the collinearity of an event with the 2D projection of its associated line. Based on these constraints, we present both linear and polynomial solvers for absolute pose estimation. The former enables efficient computation, while the latter provides a globally optimal solution for rotation. For velocity estimation, we develop an efficient linear solver and a more accurate optimization-based solver to recover both angular and linear velocities. Notably, our methods require a minimum of three event-line correspondences to determine the 6-DoF absolute pose or velocities independently. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods achieve state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in accuracy and computational efficiency compared to existing methods. The demo code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zibin6/EventPoseVelocity.

</details>


### [152] [DiffSight-Former: Modeling Structural Differences and Temporal Dynamics for Glaucoma Progression Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09140)
*Yi Huang,Lei Bi,Jinman Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiffSight-Former框架，通过时序眼底图像建模视盘/杯区与视网膜血管的多结构差异变化，结合时间感知Transformer实现青光眼进展预测，在两个纵向数据集上取得优越性能（SIGF: AUC 91.54%, 敏感性92.16%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有青光眼检测方法多依赖单时间点图像或固定长度输入，难以捕捉早期微小的纵向结构与血管变化信号，且常需已有青光眼征象的图像作为诊断线索，限制了早期预测的临床应用价值。

Method: 提出DiffSight-Former框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 基于眼底专用基础模型的时间不变特征提取模块，鲁棒提取解剖表征；(2) 多结构差异建模模块，量化视盘/杯区与视网膜血管的进展相关变化；(3) 时间感知Transformer，融合时间间隔嵌入建模疾病进展并预测未来青光眼发病概率。

Result: 在两个纵向数据集上验证：SIGF数据集AUC达91.54%、敏感性92.16%；GRAPE数据集在三种临床视野进展标准下平均准确率87.48%，在不同时间设置下表现稳健。

Conclusion: DiffSight-Former通过捕捉时序眼底图像中的多结构差异变化，实现了有效的青光眼进展预测，在纵向监测和早期风险预测方面具有潜在临床应用价值。

Abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness worldwide, and early detection from fundus images is critical for effective disease management. While deep learning has achieved promising performance in fundus image analysis, most existing methods rely on single time-point images and fail to capture longitudinal structural and vascular changes associated with disease progression. Sequential fundus images acquired during clinical follow-up provide valuable temporal information; however, current sequential models often struggle to detect subtle early progression signals and commonly depend on fixed-length inputs or diagnostic cues from already glaucomatous images, limiting their clinical utility for early prediction. To address these limitations, we propose DiffSight-Former, a framework for glaucoma progression prediction from sequential fundus images. It incorporates a time-variant feature extraction module based on a fundus-specific foundation model to obtain robust anatomical representations. A multi-structure difference modeling module is introduced to quantify progression-related changes in the optic disc/cup region and retinal vasculature. These representations are integrated with temporal interval embeddings and processed by a time-aware Transformer to model disease progression and estimate the probability of future glaucoma onset. Experiments were conducted on two longitudinal datasets, SIGF (405 sequences) and GRAPE (263 sequences). On SIGF, DiffSight-Former achieved an AUC of 91.54% and a sensitivity of 92.16% for progression prediction. On GRAPE, it achieved an average accuracy of 87.48% across three clinical visual-field progression criteria. Compared with existing approaches, DiffSight-Former demonstrates strong performance and robustness across different temporal settings, highlighting its potential for longitudinal glaucoma monitoring and early risk prediction.

</details>


### [153] [Decoding Pedestrian Crossing Intention from Egocentric Vision via Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09142)
*Danya Li,Xiang Su,Yan Feng,Rico Krueger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究从自中心短视频中解码行人过街意图，将其建模为封闭式VQA任务，利用视觉语言模型进行预测。零样本下VLM表现一般，但通过参数高效微调后显著提升，结合眼动和自运动等额外上下文线索，微调后的Qwen3-VL-2B模型相较Transformer基线提升14.5%准确率，达到新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自中心视觉在交通安全性预测中的潜力尚未被充分探索，尤其是从第一人称视角解码行人过街意图这一任务。

Method: 将任务建模为封闭式VQA问题，使用VLM进行零样本评估，然后采用参数高效微调（PEFT）适配目标任务，并引入自运动、车辆运动和眼动注视作为额外上下文线索。

Result: 零样本VLM仅比随机猜测略有提升；微调后模型显著超越零样本版本，比专用Transformer基线高9%准确率；结合眼动和自运动线索后，Qwen3-VL-2B模型准确率提升14.5%，达到新SOTA。

Conclusion: VLM通过参数高效微调并结合多模态上下文线索，能够有效解码自中心视频中的行人过街意图，在交通安全性预测方面具有广阔前景。

Abstract: Egocentric vision offers a first-person view of human perception and decision making, yet its potential for traffic-safety prediction remains underexplored. In this work, we study the decoding of pedestrian crossing intentions from short egocentric video clips. We approach this by formulating the task as a closed-ended visual question answering (VQA) problem and leveraging vision language models (VLMs) to predict the pedestrians' intent. We first benchmark three families of state-of-the-art VLMs in a zero-shot setting, finding that they achieve moderate gains over random guessing but exhibit limited higher-level traffic reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we further adapt VLMs to the target task using parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Our results show that the fine-tuned models substantially outperform their zero-shot counterparts and achieve a 9\% accuracy improvement over a specialized transformer-based baseline. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating additional contextual cues, including ego motion, vehicle motion, and eye gaze, further improves predictive performance. In particular, the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B model guided by eye gaze and ego motion achieves a 14.5% accuracy improvement over the transformer baseline, establishing a new state of the art for egocentric pedestrian intent decoding.

</details>


### [154] [CAMF-Det: Closure-Aware Multimodal Fusion for LiDAR-Camera 3D Object Detection on UAV Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09143)
*Yanze Jiang,Yanfeng Gu,Xian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAMF-Det提出了一种面向无人机平台的闭合感知多模态融合框架，通过比尔-朗伯定律启发的物理建模显式构建双模态遮挡强度先验，并将其注入数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合及检测头全流程，在自建数据集上显著提升了严重遮挡场景下的3D检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LiDAR和相机的多模态3D目标检测在地面车辆场景中表现优异，但尚未针对无人机平台进行探索。无人机俯视场景中，树冠等地面物体频繁造成遮挡，导致信息退化呈现空间变化和模态依赖特性，而现有融合框架未能显式建模这种遮挡并将其嵌入检测流程。

Method: 1) 双模态闭合建模模块：基于比尔-朗伯定律启发公式和建筑掩码校正，离线构建双模态遮挡强度真值；2) 双模态预测网络：以遮挡强度真值为监督，在单帧推理下在线预测遮挡强度；3) 将真值和预测遮挡强度注入数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合和检测头，实现自适应检测。

Result: 在两类自建无人机多模态数据集SI3D-DI和SI3D-DII上，CAMF-Det在所有难度等级上均取得最佳性能，其中困难级别的BEV mAP分别比最优对比方法提升9.43%和4.88%。

Conclusion: 显式遮挡先验建模与利用对于无人机场景下鲁棒的多模态3D检测是有效且必要的。

Abstract: Multimodal 3D object detection based on LiDAR and cameras has demonstrated excellent performance in ground-vehicle scenarios, but has not been explored for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) platforms. In UAV top-down scenes, frequent groundobject occlusion dominated by tree canopies causes spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Existing multimodal fusion frameworks neither explicitly model such ground-object occlusion nor embed occlusion awareness into the detection pipeline, limiting their performance in occluded UAV scenes. To address these challenges, we propose CAMF-Det, a closure-aware multimodal fusion framework for LiDAR-camera 3D object detection on UAV platforms, which derives dual-modal occlusion intensity through physics-inspired modeling and embeds them as priors throughout the detection pipeline. First, a dual-modal closure modeling module explicitly constructs occlusion intensity ground truth for both modalities offline via a Beer-Lambert-inspired formulation and building-mask correction. Second, using these ground-truth maps as supervision, a dual-modal prediction network converts the offline modeling results into online occlusion intensity predictions under single-frame inference. Third, both ground-truth and predicted occlusion intensity are injected into data augmentation, feature encoding, multimodal fusion, and detection head, enabling adaptive detection under spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Experiments on two self-built UAV-based multimodal datasets, SI3D-DI and SI3D-DII, demonstrate that CAMF-Det achieves the best performance across all difficulty levels, with hard-level mAP$_{\mathrm{BEV}}$ improvements of 9.43% and 4.88% over the best competing methods, respectively. These results confirm the effectiveness of explicit occlusion prior modeling and exploitation for robust multimodal 3D detection in UAV scenes.

</details>


### [155] [Ultra Flash: Scaling Real-Time Streaming Video Generation to High Resolutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09150)
*Luxury,Jie Huang,Zihao Fan,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yuming Li,Jun-hao Zhuang,Zeyue Xue,Siming Fu,Haoran Li,Mingchen Zhong,Guohui Zhang,Shichen Ma,Yijun Liu,Jiaqi Shi,Yanwen Ma,Yaofeng Su,Haoyu Wang,Yaowei Li,Songchun Zhang,Weiyang Jin,Yuxuan Bian,Shiyi Zhang,Haojun Xu,Shuai Lu,Xin Han,Wei Tang,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ultra Flash是一个级联流式视频生成框架，能够在单GPU上实现实时高清视频生成（1K分辨率约30 FPS，2K分辨率约18 FPS），通过架构保留的超分辨率训练、因果流式潜变量上采样器以及级联优化方案，显著提升了高分辨率视频生成的质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型虽能生成流畅视频，但仅局限于低分辨率（如480P），缺乏高效、可扩展的实时高分辨率视频生成方案。

Method: (1) 架构保留的T2V-to-TV2V超分辨率训练范式及面向AIGC的数据退化流程；(2) 因果流式潜变量上采样器与高分辨率解码器；(3) 级联高清流式视频生成优化方案，包括混合奖励增强的稀疏因果化、单步蒸馏、级联流式自强制偏好优化及动态缓存管理。

Result: Ultra Flash在单GPU上实现1K分辨率约30 FPS、2K分辨率约18 FPS的实时生成，在视觉质量和效率上均达到最优水平。

Conclusion: Ultra Flash可靠地生成超高分辨率流式视频，同时保持最先进的视觉质量和卓越的效率，填补了实时高分辨率视频生成的关键空白。

Abstract: While recent autoregressive video diffusion models achieve remarkable streaming quality, they remain confined to low resolutions (e.g., 480P), leaving efficient, scalable, real-time high-resolution video generation a fundamental open challenge. To bridge this gap, we present Ultra Flash, a cascaded streaming framework capable of real-time high-resolution video generation. Ultra Flash achieves ~30 FPS at 1K resolution and ~18 FPS at 2K resolution on a single GPU through three key contributions: (1) an architecture-preserving T2V-to-TV2V super-resolution training paradigm coupled with an AIGC-oriented data degradation pipeline that effectively preserves the generative capability of the base model, enabling enhanced high-resolution detail when cascaded after mainstream low-resolution generative models; (2) a causal streaming latent upsampler paired with a high-resolution decoder, which enhances spatiotemporal coherence while enabling efficient latent spatial scaling and precise high-resolution decoding with negligible computational overhead; and (3) a cascade high-resolution streaming video generation optimization scheme that first performs hybrid-reward-enhanced sparse causalization and single-step distillation of the super-resolution model, then introduces cascaded streaming self-forcing preference optimization with dynamic cache management, jointly enhancing overall coherence, improving quality, and enabling real-time high-resolution streaming video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ultra Flash reliably produces ultra-high-resolution streaming video while maintaining state-of-the-art visual quality and superior efficiency.

</details>


### [156] [OmniGen-AR: AutoRegressive Any-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09156)
*Junke Wang,Xun Wang,Qiushan Guo,Peize Sun,Weilin Huang,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniGen-AR 提出了一种统一的自回归框架用于任意条件到图像的生成，通过共享视觉分词器和解耦因果注意力机制，在单个模型中支持文本、空间信号和视觉上下文等多种条件输入，并在多个基准上达到最优或竞争性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视觉生成模型通常局限于单一模态条件（如文本），无法满足真实场景中需要从多种控制信号合成图像的多样化需求。

Method: (1) 通过共享视觉分词器离散化多种视觉条件，结合文本分词器处理文本提示，实现多模态条件统一输入；(2) 提出解耦因果注意力（DCA），将全序列因果掩码分离为条件因果注意力和内容因果注意力，作为训练时正则化项防止条件令牌到内容令牌的信息泄露，推理时仍采用标准下一个令牌预测。

Result: 在GenEval上达到0.63，在VBench上达到80.02，在多个基准上取得新SOTA或至少具有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: OmniGen-AR 验证了统一自回归框架在灵活、高保真视觉生成中的有效性，为多条件视觉生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated strong potential in visual generation, offering superior performance with simple architectures and optimization objectives. However, existing methods are typically limited to single-modality conditions, e.g., text, restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that demand image synthesis from diverse controls. In this work, we present OmniGen-AR, a unified autoregressive framework for Any-to-Image generation. By discretizing various visual conditions through a shared visual tokenizer and text prompts with a text tokenizer, OmniGen-AR supports a broad spectrum of conditional inputs within a single model, including text (text-to-image generation), spatial signals (segmentation-to-image and depth-to-image), and visual context (image editing, frame prediction, and text-to-video generation). To mitigate the risk of information leakage from condition tokens to content tokens, we introduce Disentangled Causal Attention (DCA), which separates the full-sequence causal mask into condition causal attention and content causal attention. It serves as a training-time regularizer without affecting the standard next-token prediction during inference. With this design, OmniGen-AR achieves new state-of-the-art or at least competitive results across a range of benchmark, e.g., 0.63 on GenEval and 80.02 on VBench, demonstrating its effectiveness in flexible and high-fidelity visual generation.

</details>


### [157] [Zero-Parameter Geometric Gating for Temporally Stable Low-Altitude UAV Video Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09162)
*Jingpu Yang,Fengxian Ji,Zhengzhao Lai,Juanfan Wu,Mingxuan Cui,Yufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种零参数几何门控模块，利用RANSAC单应性内点率在16×16网格上为每个区域选择单应性或光流扭曲，再通过语义相似性传播融合，在UAV语义分割中实现时域一致性提升，仅增加211K可训练参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空无人机视频语义分割需要时序一致性，但稠密光流在航拍图像占主导的平面区域中引入空间结构化噪声，现有方法缺乏针对性的无参数区域路由机制。

Method: 提出零参数几何门控：在16×16网格上计算RANSAC单应性内点率，通过中位数阈值二值决策将每个区域路由到单应性或光流扭曲，再经SSP层融合。门控本身无学习参数，仅SSP层需训练。

Result: 在合成UAVid数据集上，基于SegFormer-b2和Hiera-S+UPerNet两种架构分别提升4.24-4.91% mIoU。平面区域光流残差具有空间自相关（Moran's I=0.32），可预测边界不稳定性（Spearman ρ=0.66），刚体化使单应性有效区域时序一致性从62%提升至92%。

Conclusion: 零参数几何门控能有效路由平面与非平面区域，消除光流噪声，显著提升无人机视频语义分割的时序一致性和精度。

Abstract: Video semantic segmentation for low-altitude UAVs requires temporal consistency, yet dense optical flow introduces spatially structured noise in the planar regions that dominate aerial imagery. We propose a zero-parameter geometric gate that uses RANSAC homography inlier ratios on a $16\times16$ spatial grid to route each region to either homography or optical flow warp before fusion via Semantic Similarity Propagation. The gate requires no learned parameters -- only a median-threshold binary decision on RANSAC statistics -- adding only 211K trainable parameters (the SSP fusion layer) to a frozen backbone. On synthetic UAVid, the method achieves +4.24--4.91\% mIoU improvement over base models across two architectures (SegFormer-b2 and Hiera-S+UPerNet). Mechanism diagnostics reveal that flow residuals in planar regions are spatially autocorrelated (Moran's I = 0.32, $p < 0.001$), predict boundary instability (Spearman $ρ= 0.66$), and that rigidification recovers temporal consistency from 62\% to 92\% (+29.5pp) in homography-valid regions.

</details>


### [158] [Vision-Language Guided Hyperspectral Object Tracking via Semantics Fusion and Contextual Template Updating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09167)
*Rui Yao,Yuhong Zhang,Kunyang Sun,Hancheng Zhu,Jiaqi Zhao,Zhiwen Shao,Abdulmotaleb El Saddik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VLHTrack，一种结合大语言模型视觉语言联合跟踪框架，通过语言引导波段选择解决高光谱冗余，并利用Mamba动态模板更新处理目标形变，在HOT2023和HOT2024上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱目标跟踪中光谱冗余导致模型泛化性差，且动态场景中目标因遮挡、光照变化产生剧烈外观形变，现有时序建模方法难以应对。

Method: 1) Language-Guided Band Selection Module (LBSM)：利用LLM描述建立语义到光谱映射，选择判别性波段；2) Multi-Modal Vision-Language Fusion Module：融合视觉与语言嵌入学习跨模态表示；3) Dynamic Template Update with Mamba (DTUM)：通过选择性状态空间建模学习帧间依赖，动态更新模板特征。

Result: 在HOT2023和HOT2024基准上超越现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 语言先验可有效缓解光谱冗余，Mamba动态模板更新能应对长时序目标形变，视觉-语言联合框架在高光谱跟踪中具有显著优势。

Abstract: Hyperspectral object tracking (HOT) leverages the rich spectral information provided by hyperspectral videos (HSVs), offering substantial potential for object tracking. However, efficiently extracting and exploiting spectral information from redundant spectral bands remains a fundamental challenge, which severely limits model generalization and tracking performance. Moreover, in dynamic scenes, targets often experience drastic appearance variations due to factors such as occlusion and illumination changes. These variations lead to large deformations between the current frame and the template. Such discrepancies pose major challenges for existing temporal modeling approaches. In this work, we propose VLHTrack, a novel hyperspectral vision-language (VL) joint tracking framework. Specifically, we incorporate language priors to address the fundamental challenge of spectral redundancy by designing a Language-Guided Band Selection Module (LBSM). By leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) descriptions, LBSM establishes a semantic-to-spectral mapping that mitigates redundancy and accentuates discriminative spectral features. A Multi-Modal Vision-Language Fusion Module is then employed to seamlessly integrate visual and linguistic embeddings, harnessing their complementary advantages to learn coherent cross-modal representations. To address target deformation in long-term sequences, we propose a dynamic update template feature strategy implemented via the Dynamic Template Update with Mamba (DTUM) module. By leveraging selective state space modeling, DTUM learns inter-frame dependencies to update template feature, ensuring efficient template feature evolution guided by temporal context. Experiments on HOT2023 and HOT2024 demonstrate that VLHTrack outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

</details>


### [159] [Claude Code-Driving Scenario Mining for the Argoverse 2 Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09180)
*Wei Deng,Caoshengzhe Xue,Shuaikun Liu,Zhaohong Liu,Mengshi Qi,Huadong Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种四阶段管道用于CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Challenge，包括基于GLM 5.1的Claude Code自主代码生成、迭代训练集筛选、语义代码审查和Qwen3-VL场景级验证，并在Argoverse 2测试集上报告结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Challenge，旨在通过自动化代码生成和多阶段验证提升场景挖掘的准确性和效率。

Method: 四阶段管道：(1) 基于GLM 5.1的Claude Code智能体自主生成代码；(2) 使用Timestamp Balanced Accuracy阈值0.8进行迭代训练集筛选，构建少样本示例；(3) 由独立的Claude Code会话进行语义代码审查；(4) Qwen3-VL进行场景级验证以过滤误报。

Result: 在Argoverse 2测试集上报告了实验结果，但摘要未提供具体数值。

Conclusion: 该四阶段自动化管道能有效提升场景挖掘任务的性能，结合大语言模型代码生成与多模态验证可减少人工干预。

Abstract: We present our submission to the CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Challenge. Our system uses a four-stage pipeline: (1) autonomous code generation via a Claude Code agent powered by GLM~5.1, (2) iterative training set screening with Timestamp Balanced Accuracy threshold 0.8 to curate few-shot examples, (3) semantic code review by a separate Claude Code session, and (4) Qwen3-VL scene-level verification to filter false positives. We report results on the Argoverse 2 test set.

</details>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [160] [Bidirectional Small-Granularity Search between Code and Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07519)
*Marco A. Valenzuela-Escárcega,Enrique Noriega-Atala,Gus Hahn-Powell,Clayton T. Morrison,Mihai Surdeanu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了代码与文本之间的双向小粒度搜索任务，构建了包含GPT-4自动生成数据的大规模数据集，并提出了一个共享编码器的模块化方法，在域内和域外均取得了有前景的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在科学出版物中，文本描述与对应代码片段之间缺乏直接、细粒度的链接，这阻碍了对科学方法的快速理解和复现。现有工作多聚焦于大规模代码-文本检索，缺乏对小粒度双向搜索的研究。

Method: 提出模块化方法，使用共享编码器处理四个不同的子任务，分别学习两个方向（代码→文本和文本→代码）上的答案起止跨度预测。

Result: 在域内数据集上取得了良好结果，在域外数据集上也获得了令人鼓舞的结果，表明使用自动生成数据解决该任务是可行的。

Conclusion: 自动生成数据可用于解决代码-文本双向小粒度搜索任务，但仍存在挑战，未来工作值得进一步探索。

Abstract: We introduce the novel task of bidirectional small-granularity search between code and text, where the queries are small snippets of text or code and the results are also small fragments of the opposite modality, i.e., code or text. This task establishes direct links between text in scientific publications and corresponding code segments, in support of better and faster understanding of scientific methods. We introduce a large dataset for the proposed task that includes a training partition with textual descriptions of code generated automatically using GPT-4, and three testing partitions, one in-domain and two out-of-domain (OOD) that contain manually-annotated data as well as material from other domains. We also propose a modular approach to address this task. Our approach shares an encoder across four different subtasks that learn start/end of answer spans in both directions. We show that our method achieves good results in-domain, and encouraging results OOD. This suggests that addressing this task with automatically-generated data is possible, but there is exciting future work to be done.

</details>


### [161] [TinyJudge: Unverifiable Constraint Alignment via Lightweight Specialist Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07520)
*Yirong Zeng,Yufei Liu,Xiao Ding,Yutai Hou,Yuxian Wang,Wu Ning,Haonan Song,Dandan Tu,Qixun Zhang,Yuxiang He,Bibo Cai,Ting Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TinyJudge框架，通过集成多个0.6B参数的小型语言模型作为奖励模型，解决LLM在指令遵循任务中奖励作弊和计算开销大的问题，在五个基准上平均性能提升约10%，奖励精度提升12%，训练速度提升3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法在LLM指令遵循任务中面临严重的奖励作弊问题和较高的计算开销，需要更高效的奖励评估方案。

Method: 首先分析不可验证约束的泛化能力，发现特定约束具有独特的高泛化模式；然后提出TinyJudge框架，集成多个约0.6B参数的专业小语言模型作为奖励模型，通过从前沿模型蒸馏知识实现高精度轻量级评估。

Result: 在五个基准上，TinyJudge相比基线平均性能提升约10%，奖励精度提升12%，训练时间加速3倍。

Conclusion: TinyJudge为将LLM与不可验证的人类指令对齐提供了一条可扩展且鲁棒的路径，有效解决了奖励作弊和计算效率问题。

Abstract: Instruction Following (IF) is a core capability of LLMs, requiring strict adherence to diverse constraints, ranging from verifiable ones (e.g., output length) to unverifiable ones (e.g., tone). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a paradigm for IF tasks, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge to assess unverifiable constraints. However, we empirically find that this approach remains a significant bottleneck, suffering from severe reward hacking and higher computational overhead. In this work, we first analyze the generalization capabilities of unverifiable constraints and discover that specific constraints exhibit distinct, high-generalization patterns. Motivated by this, we propose TinyJudge, a framework that employs an ensemble of specialized tiny language models ($\sim0.6B$) to provide rewards for soft constraints. By distilling expertise from frontier models into these tiny models, it achieves high-precision, lightweight evaluation. Extensive evaluations across five benchmarks demonstrate that TinyJudge outperforms the baselines by $\sim10\%$ in average performance and $12\%$ in reward precision. Crucially, it also achieves a $3\times$ speedup in total training time. Our work provides a scalable and robust path for aligning LLMs with unverifiable human instructions.

</details>


### [162] [Evaluating Hallucinations in Domain-Adapted Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07521)
*Sanchita Porwal,Sai Prasath S,Xingjian Bi,Madelyn Scandlen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究调查了领域自适应大语言模型（LLMs）中的幻觉现象，聚焦于使用Lamini数据集微调Llama-2模型。通过一系列测试记忆、回忆和推理能力的实验，发现微调后的模型虽然在类似训练数据的任务上表现良好，但在准确推理和回忆新的领域特定信息方面能力有限，导致幻觉产生。模型倾向于给出正确答案但附带额外信息，显示出过度生成倾向。结果表明仅依赖微调方法在将LLMs适配到专业领域时减轻幻觉存在重要局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在领域自适应微调过程中会产生幻觉（生成无意义或不忠实的内容），这一问题在模型使用领域特定数据微调时尤为突出。本研究旨在深入探究这一现象，揭示微调方法在缓解领域适配中的幻觉问题方面的局限性。

Method: 以Llama-2为基础模型，使用Lamini数据集进行微调，设计了一系列实验分别测试模型的记忆、回忆和推理能力。通过比较模型在新型问答对和领域特定信息上的表现来评估幻觉现象。

Result: 模型在训练数据相似任务上表现良好，但准确推理和回忆新的领域特定信息的能力有限，导致幻觉产生。模型倾向于给出正确答案但附带额外信息（过度生成倾向），且在领域特定查询上的表现相对较弱。

Conclusion: 仅依赖微调的方法在将大语言模型适配到专业领域时，在减轻幻觉方面存在重要局限性，亟需开发更鲁棒的方法来增强LLMs的领域适配能力。

Abstract: This study investigates the phenomenon of hallucinations in domain-adapted Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on the fine-tuning of the Llama-2 model with the Lamini dataset. Hallucinations, or the generation of nonsensical or unfaithful content by LLMs, pose a significant challenge, especially when these models are fine-tuned with domain-specific data. Our methodology involves a series of experiments testing memorization, recall, and reasoning capabilities of the fine-tuned LLM, comparing its performance on novel question-answer pairs and domain-specific information. We found that while the model shows proficiency in tasks similar to its training data, its capability to accurately reason about and recall new domain-specific information remains limited, leading to instances of hallucination. The model demonstrates a tendency to provide correct answers with extra information, suggesting an inclination toward over-generation. These results suggest important limitations of fine-tuning-only approaches for mitigating hallucinations when adapting LLMs to specialized domains and underscore the need for more robust methods in adapting LLMs to specialized domains. The study also provides insights into the varying performance of LLMs on different types of information, revealing a comparative weakness in handling domain-specific queries.

</details>


### [163] [Community-Specific Slang and Entity Detection via Semantic Shift in Fine-Tuned Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07522)
*Julia Kruk,Sanchita Porwal,Amitrajit Bhattacharjee,Mansi Phute*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种无监督方法，通过测量预训练大语言模型在社区特定语料上微调后词汇语义迁移的幅度，来解析网络社区中的俚语、独特实体和民间传说。在3个Reddit子版块上微调DistilRoBERTa模型，通过余弦相似度分布底部10%的词汇成功识别出社区特有词汇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络社区中大量使用俚语、特有实体和民间传说，传统方法难以自动解析这些社区特定的语义变化，需要一种无监督的方法来识别这些词汇。

Method: 定义语义迁移为在社区特定语料上微调预训练LLM后词汇编码表征的变化量，该值与微调前后词汇表征的余弦相似度成反比。使用DistilRoBERTa模型，在3个Reddit子版块语料上微调，建模词汇余弦相似度分布，取底部10%作为社区特有词汇。

Result: 底部10%的词汇成功解析了社区特有意义的词汇（俚语、独特实体、民间传说），而顶部10%的词汇则具有普遍语义。

Conclusion: 通过测量语义迁移幅度可以无监督地识别网络社区中的特有词汇，该方法有效且可推广。

Abstract: We propose an unsupervised method of resolving slang, unique entities, and folklore from online communities by isolating words in the lexicon that have the highest magnitude of semantic shift. Semantic shift is defined as the evolution of a word's encoded representation as a result of fine-tuning a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM) on a community-specific text corpus. This value is inversely proportional to the cosine similarity between the base model's encoded representation of a word, and a fine-tuned model's encoded representation. We fine-tune the DistilRoBERTa model on text corpora collected from 3 Reddit subreddits (r/Technology, r/Gaming, r/WorldofWarcraft), model a distribution of cosine similarity over the lexicon, and show that one can successfully resolve words that have unique significance to the community by pulling data in the bottom 10-percentile. In contrast, we show that data in the top 10-percentile consist of words that carry relatively universal semantics.

</details>


### [164] [Retrieval Augmented Generation Framework for the Nepali Legal Domain Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07523)
*Samir Wagle,Abiral Adhikari,Reewaj Khanal,Batsal Bhandari,Prashant Manandhar,Praveen Acharya,Bal Krishna Bal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次将检索增强生成（RAG）模型应用于尼泊尔语法律问答，利用BM25和E5检索器从尼泊尔法律文献中检索案例，实现了91%的P@1和74-85%的真实性/接地性评分，证明了RAG在低资源语言法律领域中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言（如尼泊尔语）缺乏法律领域的大规模标注数据和预训练语言模型，导致法律AI应用滞后。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为尼泊尔法律问答提供可靠的AI解决方案。

Method: 采用检索增强生成（RAG）框架，从尼泊尔Kanun Patrika数字档案中提取案例法，使用BM25对分块文档进行检索，同时对比多语言E5大模型。检索到的文档用于引导生成模型回答法律问题。

Result: BM25检索实现91%的P@1，多语言E5模型达到75%的P@1。生成答案的接地性为74%，自动评判的真实性为85%，人工评估的真实性为84%，成功回答生成率为92%。

Conclusion: RAG流水线能有效解决低资源语言法律问答的空白，为尼泊尔法律领域可靠AI系统奠定了基础。

Abstract: Legal domains in high-resource languages like English have widely adopted artificial intelligence for legal question answering. However, data scarcity in low resource languages such as Nepali has limited the training of large language models on Nepali legal texts. This study presents the first application of a Retrieval Augmented Generation based model for Nepali legal question answering using case laws extracted from the Nepal Kanun Patrika digital archive. Using BM25 on chunked documents, the approach achieved a top precision at one of 91 percent, and up to 75 percent with the multilingual E5 large model. Evaluation of generated answers showed 74 percent groundedness, 85 percent truthfulness according to an automated judge model, and 84 percent human evaluated truthfulness when using BM25 document retrieval, with a 92 percent successful answer generation rate. These results demonstrate that the RAG pipeline can effectively address the gap in legal question answering for low resource languages and provide a foundation for reliable AI systems in the Nepali legal domain.

</details>


### [165] [ABLE: Representing and Mapping LLMs via Attribution-Based Large-model Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07524)
*Zirui Wang,Yusen Hou,Shaofeng Liang,Bowen Tian,Yanlin Zhang,Wenshuo Chen,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ABLE框架，利用基于梯度的特征归因和与分词器无关的词级对齐来构建LLM嵌入表示，在239个开源模型上实现了关系预测、模型路由和基准分数预测的竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在面对LLM生态系统的异构性和文档匮乏时，要么受限于架构兼容性（内部参数方法），要么混淆模型行为且难以跨分词器对齐（外部输出方法），亟需一种高效且通用的模型表示方法。

Method: ABLE利用可解释性空间构建模型表示：通过聚合基于梯度的特征归因，并采用与分词器无关的词级对齐策略，捕获模型特定的输入敏感性模式。

Result: 在239个开源LLM上的实验表明，无训练方法ABLE在关系预测、模型路由和基准分数预测任务上达到竞争性或更优性能。

Conclusion: ABLE提供了一种无需训练的LLM嵌入方法，具有Lipschitz连续性和有限样本收敛保证，有效桥接了现有方法的局限性。

Abstract: The explosive growth of large language models (LLMs) has created a heterogeneous and poorly documented ecosystem, making systematic model comparison increasingly important for provenance auditing, security analysis, and model selection. Existing representation methods struggle to address this setting efficiently. Approaches analyzing internal parameters are powerful when architectures are compatible, but face scalability barriers under structural heterogeneity, while methods relying on external outputs may conflate models with similar behaviors and are difficult to align in richer output spaces across different tokenizers. To bridge this gap, we propose ABLE (Attribution-Based Large-model Embedding), a framework that leverages the interpretability space to construct model representations. By aggregating gradient-based feature attributions via a tokenizer-agnostic word-level alignment, ABLE captures model-specific input-sensitivity patterns rather than only surface-level outputs. Beyond empirical utility, we provide a stability analysis showing that, under standard regularity assumptions for differentiable Transformer-style models, ABLE induces a Lipschitz-continuous parameter-to-embedding map with finite-sample convergence guarantees. Extensive experiments on 239 open-source LLMs demonstrate that our training-free approach achieves competitive or superior performance in relation prediction, model routing, and benchmark score prediction.

</details>


### [166] [Implicit Causal Graph Construction in Text via Chain Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07525)
*Liesbeth Allein,Marie-Francine Moens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究从文本中进行隐式因果图构建，通过将因果对视为潜在因果图的起点和终点，利用大语言模型推断中间因果事件，并比较了端到端构建、因果链发现以及多LLM协作等方法，使用含1,560个科学验证因果对的手动数据库评估因果关系的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果图研究通常依赖文本中显式、可观测的预定义事件，缺乏对隐式因果关系的建模能力。作者旨在探索利用LLM从文本中推断潜在因果图中间节点的方法，以填补这一空白。

Method: 将文本中的因果对视为潜在因果图的起点和终点，利用LLM推断中间因果事件。比较了端到端图构建与因果链发现两种框架，后者通过聚合推断链或迭代搜索逐步扩展部分链来构建图。此外，还探索了"群体智慧"扩展，即在事后聚合和协作推理设置中访问多个LLM的因果知识。

Result: 构建了一个包含1,560个科学验证因果对的手动 curated 数据库用于评估，提出了该评估方法具有可靠性、资源高效性和可迁移性，适用于缺乏真实图的场景。

Conclusion: 基于数据库的评估方法被证明是可靠且资源高效的，能够迁移到缺少真实因果图的场景。本文为隐式因果图构建提供了多种方法的比较分析。

Abstract: Causal graphs in text are typically populated by observable, predefined events. In contrast, we study implicit causal graph construction from text by treating each described cause-effect pair as the begin- and endpoint of an underlying latent causal graph and using large language models (LLMs) to infer intermediate causal events. We compare end-to-end graph construction with methods that frame the task as causal chain discovery. In the latter, graphs are built either by aggregating inferred chains or by progressively expanding partial chains through an iterative search process. We further explore Wisdom of the Crowd extensions that access causal knowledge from multiple LLMs in post-hoc aggregation and collaborative inference settings. We analyze trade-offs among these approaches and evaluate the validity of inferred causal relations using a manually curated database of 1,560 scientifically validated causal pairs. This database-based evaluation is proposed as reliable, resource-efficient, and transferable to settings where ground-truth graphs are unavailable.

</details>


### [167] [GraphLoRA: Structure-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07526)
*Lin Mu,Guoji Wang,Li Ni,Lei Sang,Zhize Wu,Peiquan Jin,Yiwen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GraphLoRA通过在低秩适配路径中嵌入可训练图消息传递网络，实现图结构与文本语义的深度融合，在LLM推荐任务中超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法将协同信号视为静态输入，未能捕获高阶关系依赖，导致LLM建模的文本语义与协同信号之间对齐不足。

Method: 提出GraphLoRA框架，在低秩适配（LoRA）路径中嵌入可训练的图消息传递网络，使结构信号通过参数空间传播，实现图结构与文本语义的深度集成。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，GraphLoRA优于现有最先进的基于LLM的推荐方法，并展现出更强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: GraphLoRA有效平衡了结构推理能力与计算效率，为LLM推荐中结构-语义融合提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for recommendation (LLMRec) due to their powerful reasoning and generalization abilities. However, effectively aligning the textual semantics modeled by LLMs with the collaborative signals remains a key challenge. Existing methods either translate collaborative information into textual prompts or inject pre-trained embeddings into the LLM, both of which treat structural information as static input and fail to capture high-order relational dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose GraphLoRA, a novel framework that generalizes low-rank adaptation from independent to structure-aware propagation. GraphLoRA embeds a trainable graph message-passing network within the low-rank adaptation pathway, enabling structural signals to propagate through the parameter space. This design allows collaborative topology to explicitly guide parameter updates, fostering deep integration between graph-structured and textual semantic information. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that GraphLoRA not only outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based recommendation methods but also achieves superior generalization, effectively balancing structural reasoning capability with computational efficiency. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/wgj15965/GraphLoRA}{https://github.com/wgj15965/GraphLoRA}.

</details>


### [168] [Post-training is (Massive) Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07527)
*Michael Hassid,Yossi Adi,Roy Schwartz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出当前LLM的后训练范式（SFT+RL）实质上回归了BERT时代的"预训练-微调"模式，即通过后训练使模型拟合特定分布和基准。实验表明，从随机初始化开始后训练也能取得显著性能，说明当前后训练主要起分布拟合作用。作者主张应转向"学会如何学习"的训练范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战当前LLM大规模后训练（SFT+RL）的主流范式，指出其本质上是回归了早期"预训练-微调"的分布拟合模式，阻碍了通用能力的真正发展。

Method: 历史回顾与实证分析：1）梳理LLM发展的不同阶段；2）对比预训练模型与随机初始化模型在推理数据集上微调后，在数学和代码基准上的性能差异。

Result: 从随机初始化开始后训练的模型在数学和代码基准上取得了非平凡的性能，表明当前后训练主要起到分布拟合的作用，而非真正释放预训练学到的通用知识。

Conclusion: 当前后训练范式存在局限，发展真正通用能力的模型需要超越针对预定义行为的大规模后训练，转向能使模型"学会如何学习"的训练方法。

Abstract: The prevailing paradigm for training LLMs has evolved to rely on a massive post-training phase consisting of SFT and RL. In this position paper, we argue that this methodology effectively marks a reversion to the ``pre-train then fine-tune'' approach of the BERT era, explicitly tailoring models to the desired behaviors and specific benchmarks on which they are evaluated. We begin with a historical overview of LLMs, describing the different phases of the LLM evolution. We argue that the current landscape is remarkably similar to the early days of LLMs, where task performance heavily relied on fitting the models to in-distribution datasets. To empirically demonstrate this, we compare pre-trained models to randomly initialized ones, by fine-tuning both variants on modern reasoning datasets and evaluating them on competitive math and code benchmarks. We show that models post-trained from scratch yield highly non-trivial performance. Our findings suggest that current post-training methodologies function primarily as a distribution-fitting mechanism. We finish by positing that developing generally capable models and systems requires moving beyond extensive post-training for predefined behaviors, shifting instead toward training procedures where models ``learn how to learn''.

</details>


### [169] [BEACON: Behavioral Entropy Aggregation for Cross-Model Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07528)
*Naveen Bera,Pulijala Sai Nikhila,Kondaguduru Abhiram,Shaik Gayaz Ali,Shoaib Sadiq Salehmohamed,Shaik Mohammed Omar,Jinal Prashant Thakkar,Hansika Aredla,Shalmali Ayachit*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BEACON是一个无需访问模型内部表示或外部知识库的黑盒幻觉检测框架，通过从结构化多轮生成中提取31维特征向量，结合NLI语义熵、嵌入几何、思维链一致性和释义稳定性信号，使用梯度提升分类器在7,617个标注样本上达到0.8123 AUROC，显著优于现有方法。高效5次调用变体达到0.7795 AUROC，适用于黑盒LLM API部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型中的幻觉问题（生成事实不正确或无法支持的内容）严重阻碍了其可靠部署，现有检测方法往往需要访问模型内部表征或依赖外部知识库，缺乏通用且实用的黑盒检测方案。

Method: BEACON框架从结构化多轮生成中提取31维特征向量，集成四种信号：NLI（自然语言推理）语义熵、嵌入几何特征、思维链一致性和释义稳定性；使用梯度提升分类器在7,617个标注样本上训练。

Result: 在七个基准上AUROC达0.8123±0.0102（95% CI: 0.7632-0.8251），比独立语义熵高出0.2298，比SelfCheckGPT风格一致性基线高出0.2457。5次调用高效变体AUROC为0.7795。

Conclusion: 幻觉检测本质上需要多维度信息，单一的语义熵或一致性信号不足以有效检测；BEACON作为纯黑盒方法，在不访问模型内部结构或外部知识的前提下实现了优异性能，且高效变体可实际部署于商业LLM API。

Abstract: Hallucination in large language models (LLMs), defined as the generation of factually incorrect or unsupported content, remains a critical barrier to reliable deployment. We present BEACON (Behavioral Entropy Aggregation for Cross-model hallucination detectiON), a black-box hallucination detection framework that operates purely on model outputs without requiring access to internal representations or external knowledge bases. BEACON extracts a 31-dimensional feature vector from structured multi-pass generation, integrating NLI-based semantic entropy, embedding geometry, chain-of-thought consistency, and paraphrase stability signals. A gradient-boosted classifier trained on 7,617 labeled examples across seven benchmarks achieves 0.8123 +/- 0.0102 AUROC (95% CI: 0.7632-0.8251), outperforming standalone semantic entropy (+0.2298) and SelfCheckGPT-style consistency baselines (+0.2457). Feature importance analysis shows that hallucination is inherently multi-dimensional, requiring combined uncertainty signals. An efficient 5-call variant achieves 0.7795 AUROC, enabling practical deployment across black-box LLM APIs.

</details>


### [170] [CAPruner: Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner for Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07529)
*Shengli Zhou,Xiangchen Wang,Guanhua Chen,Feng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CAPruner，通过融合模糊语义相关性和空间邻近性来剪枝场景图，保留对3D视觉-语言任务最关键的空间关系，从而降低LLM的推理成本并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景图剪枝方法主要依赖空间邻近性，常误删任务相关关系，损害空间推理能力；同时完整场景图推理导致高token成本和计算低效。

Method: 提出CAPruner，集成模糊语义相关性与空间邻近性评估关系重要性，通过监督节点入射边的聚合分数进行训练，避免昂贵的关系级标注。

Result: 实验表明CAPruner有效保留空间推理所需关系，显著提升LLM在3D-VL任务上的性能。

Conclusion: 融合语义与空间信息的剪枝策略优于纯空间邻近性方法，为3D-VL任务中的场景图高效推理提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to 3D vision-language (3D-VL) tasks, which require spatial reasoning to identify target objects relative to anchors. Scene graphs are commonly employed to represent such relations, but reasoning over complete graphs incurs high token costs and computational inefficiencies, motivating the need for pruning. Existing pruning methods primarily rely on spatial proximity and often remove task-relevant relations, thereby undermining reliable spatial reasoning. To address these limitations, we derive a key requirement for scene graph pruning: preserving spatial relations that are most pertinent to the specific 3D-VL task. Guided by this insight, we propose the Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner (CAPruner). CAPruner integrates fuzzy semantic relevance with spatial proximity to estimate the importance of relations, enabling the selection of critical relations in a task-specific context. Moreover, to avoid costly relation-level annotations, CAPruner is trained by supervising the aggregated scores of each node's incident edges. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAPruner effectively preserves relations essential for spatial reasoning, leading to substantial performance improvements of LLMs on 3D-VL tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/fz-zsl/CAPruner.

</details>


### [171] [Finding New Connections between Concepts from Medline Database Incorporating Domain Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07530)
*Yang Weikang,Chowdhury S. M. Mazharul Hoque,Jin Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于Don R. Swanson的ABC模型，提出一种改进的自适应文献发现模型，用于挖掘医学概念间隐藏的间接关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据在数字世界中相互关联，许多看似无关的主题实际上通过共同主题存在隐藏关联，现有方法未能充分挖掘这些间接联系。

Method: 对Swanson的ABC文献发现模型进行自适应改进，通过识别连接两个看似无关概念（A和C）的共同中间概念（B），来发现医学概念间的隐藏关联。

Result: 改进后的自适应模型能够有效发现医学概念间的间接关联路径。

Conclusion: 自适应ABC模型可用于挖掘医学领域中概念间的隐藏关联，有助于发现新的知识连接。

Abstract: In this digital world, data is everything and significantly impacts our everyday lives. Interestingly, in this small world, everything is part of an ecosystem, where everything is connected, directly or indirectly. The same thing happens to data as well. In most cases, it may seem like a particular topic does not have any connection with another one, but in reality, they are connected through a mutually related topic. Therefore, in this research, we will discuss an adaptive model modified from the ABC model by Don R. Swanson, a Literature-Based Discovery (LBD) Model, to find the hidden connections between Concepts of Interest. The model demonstrates that two topics, A and C are different and have no relationship. But they have a common topic, B that can be used to connect topics A and C This famous model will be used in this discussion to connect Medical Concepts.

</details>


### [172] [mllm-shap: A Shapley Value Explainability Platform for Text-Audio Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07531)
*Jakub Muszyński,Paweł Pozorski,Maria Ganzha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: mllm-shap是一个开源Python框架，将Shapley值可解释性从纯文本LLM扩展到处理文本和音频的多模态LLM，解决了模态感知掩蔽、多轮对话追踪和音素对齐分组三大挑战，实现了计算可行的SV估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Shapley值可解释性方法主要针对纯文本LLM，而多模态LLM（特别是文本-音频联合输入场景）面临独特的计算和结构性挑战，包括文本token与音频帧的混合处理、多轮对话中的角色/模态上下文维护，以及长音频带来的巨大组合空间问题。

Method: 提出了三个关键技术：(1) 模态感知联盟掩蔽，管理离散文本token与密集音频编码器帧的交错处理；(2) 多轮对话追踪，利用逐token元数据维护角色和模态上下文；(3) 音素对齐分词分组，将组合空间缩小10-50倍。实现了五种SV估计策略，包括互补贡献(CC)估计器及Neyman最优分配。

Result: CC估计器在收敛性上优于标准蒙特卡洛基线；音素对齐分组使SV估计在长音频场景下计算可行；提供了pip可安装的交互式Web GUI可视化工具。

Conclusion: mllm-shap是首个公开可用的、提供完整可复现管道的文本-音频多模态LLM的SV可解释性框架。

Abstract: We introduce mllm-shap, an open-source Python framework designed to extend Shapley Value (SV) explainability from text-only Large Language Models to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) processing joint text and audio inputs. While text-based attribution is well-studied, mllm-shap addresses three critical challenges unique to the multimodal regime:
  (1) Modality-aware coalition masking, which manages the interleaved processing of discrete text tokens and dense audio encoder frames.
  (2) Multi-turn conversation tracking, utilizing per-token metadata to maintain role and modality context.
  (3) Phonetic alignment-based token grouping, a novel technique that reduces the coalition space by 10x to 50x, rendering SV estimation computationally feasible for long-form audio.
  The platform implements five SV estimation strategies, including a Complementary Contributions (CC) estimator with Neyman-optimal allocation that demonstrates superior convergence over standard Monte Carlo baselines. mllm-shap is provided as a pip-installable package featuring an interactive web-based GUI for granular attribution visualization. To our knowledge, this is the first publicly available framework providing a complete, reproducible pipeline for SV-based explainability in text-audio MLLMs.

</details>


### [173] [Principled Agent Debate: Adversarial Arbitration for Sycophancy Reduction in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07532)
*Sam Ryan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RLHF训练的模型存在系统性同意偏差。本文提出原则性智能体辩论（PAD）架构，通过两个持对立哲学倾向的模型独立辩论，并由实用主义合成器盲审仲裁来缓解谄媚问题。DeWin变体在SycophancyEval上达到48.5%准确率，显著优于单模型基线（18.5%）和指令对立基线（29.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF训练使模型产生系统性同意偏差（即谄媚现象），这一结构性缺陷导致模型倾向于赞同用户立场而非追求事实准确性，亟需有效的缓解方法。

Method: 提出原则性智能体辩论（PAD）架构，包含三个关键机制：静态倾向微调（使两个模型持对立哲学立场）、身份剥离（合成前去除生成者身份信息）、单轮独立论证（模型独立生成论点）、盲审仲裁（实用主义合成器基于内容而非来源评估论点）。在SycophancyEval的200个分层问题上评估了五个变体（AnCifer, DeWin, FeynStein, BurGal, Trident）。

Result: 所有PAD变体均显著优于单模型基线（18.5%）和指令对立基线（29.0%）。最优变体DeWin达到48.5%准确率（z=6.36, p<0.001）。BurGal达到53.0%但存在结构性偏向问题。各变体间在n=200时无显著差异。约40%的问题受预训练下限限制。

Conclusion: PAD架构能有效缓解RLHF模型的谄媚偏差，但存在预训练知识下限瓶颈。下一步方向是微调具有特定倾向的模型以突破此瓶颈。

Abstract: RLHF-trained models are systematically biased toward agreement over accuracy, a structural property of the training process. We present Principled Agent Debate (PAD), a multi-agent architecture that mitigates identity-framed sycophancy by arbitrating between two models tuned to opposing philosophical dispositions, with a pragmatist synthesizer evaluating both arguments blind to their origins. This paper evaluates a prompt-based instantiation of PAD. The key mechanisms are static dispositional tuning, identity stripping before synthesis, single-round independent argumentation, and blind arbitration. We evaluate five instantiations on 200 stratified questions from SycophancyEval. All PAD variants (AnCifer, DeWin, FeynStein, BurGal, Trident) significantly outperform the single-model baseline (18.5%) and instructed-opposition baseline (29.0%), with DeWin achieving 48.5% accuracy (z=6.36, p<0.001 versus both). The variants are not significantly different from each other at n=200. The BurGal variant achieves 53.0% but functions as an architectural validity check; its consensus/heterodox axis structurally favors the heterodox model on every benchmark question. A pre-training floor affects an estimated 40% of questions; fine-tuned disposition models are the identified next step.

</details>


### [174] [Bridging Traditional Explainability Methods and Multimodal Multilingual Models: An XAI-Based Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07533)
*Paweł Pozorski,Jakub Muszyński,Maria Ganzha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了多模态Shapley值框架，将文本和音频作为协同特征进行归因解释，结合高效估算策略和频谱引导音素对齐方法，并开源了Python包和GUI工具。实验表明输入模态是归因波动的主要驱动因素，标准句法重要性代理在多模态跨语言场景中无法预测模型注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽能有效整合文本与音频，但其内部异构模态如何影响模型行为的机制仍不透明，现有Shapley值方法在扩展至多模态数据时面临跨通道依赖、复杂对话结构和音频表征计算开销高等挑战。

Method: 形式化多模态Shapley值框架，将离散文本token和对齐音频片段视为合作特征；采用精确SV计算（低维）和采样近似（蒙特卡洛排列、Neyman最优分配分层抽样）保证计算可行性；提出频谱引导音素对齐（SGPA）将高频音频映射为可解释的词级对齐片段；开发开源Python包和GUI工具。

Result: 输入模态是归因波动的主要驱动因素；标准句法重要性代理在多模态、跨语言上下文中无法预测模型注意力。

Conclusion: 该框架为多模态模型的归因解释提供了可行的计算方案，揭示了模态对模型行为的关键影响，并提供了开源工具以便社区使用和扩展。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively integrate text and audio to interpret context in complex interactive dialogues. However, the internal mechanisms by which heterogeneous modalities influence model behavior remain opaque. While Shapley Values (SV) provide a robust, model-agnostic framework for local explainability in text-based NLP, their extension to multimodal data is hindered by cross-channel dependencies, intricate dialogue structures, and the prohibitive computational complexity of dense audio representations.
  In this work, we formalize a multimodal extension of the Shapley Value framework, treating discrete text tokens and aligned audio segments as cooperative features. To ensure computational feasibility, we deploy a suite of efficient estimation strategies: exact SV computation for low-dimensional inputs and sampling-based approximations - including Monte Carlo permutations and stratified sampling with Neyman-optimal allocation - to minimize variance under constrained computational budgets. To resolve the granularity mismatch between modalities, we propose Spectrogram-Guided Phonetic Alignment (SGPA), a novel preprocessing method that maps high-frequency audio streams to interpretable, word-aligned segments.
  Our contribution is twofold: first, we provide an open-source, model-agnostic Python package and a companion GUI for the computation and interactive visualization of multimodal attributions. Second, we evaluate our framework using curated subsets of the VoiceBench and Infinity Instruct datasets across diverse multilingual scenarios. Our experimental results reveal that input modality is a primary driver of attribution volatility and demonstrate that standard syntactic importance proxies often fail to predict model attention in multimodal, cross-lingual contexts.

</details>


### [175] [Multilingual Refusal Alignment for Safer Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07535)
*Aleksandra Krasnodębska,Wojciech Kusa,Aldo Lipani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了多语言对齐的动态机制，发现仅用英语进行对齐训练不足以确保跨语言安全性，而多语言数据集训练可在不降低通用性能的前提下提升安全性。作者提出了包含12种欧洲语言的RefusEU拒绝对齐数据集，并通过受控DPO实验验证了核心观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM在全球范围部署，其安全行为在不同语言间表现出不可预测的差异，亟需系统研究多语言对齐的动力学机制，特别是单语言对齐是否具有跨语言迁移能力、训练过程中语言一致性如何保持，以及对齐与通用知识能力之间的权衡关系。

Method: 构建了RefusEU多语言拒绝对齐数据集（覆盖12种欧洲语言及测试集），采用受控的Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)实验范式，对比仅英语对齐与多语言对齐的效果，并使用Global MMLU基准评估通用性能。

Result: 仅用英语对齐不足以确保同类别危害下的跨语言安全性；多语言数据集训练能够提升安全性且不损害通用性能（Global MMLU指标未下降）。

Conclusion: 多语言对齐训练是实现跨语言安全一致性的必要条件，且不会对通用知识能力产生负面影响。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed globally, ensuring their safety and alignment across multiple languages becomes paramount. However, safety behaviors often vary unpredictably between languages, posing significant challenges for consistent and ethical AI. In this work, we systematically investigate the dynamics of multilingual alignment, exploring whether single-language alignment transfers cross-lingually, how language consistency is preserved during training, and the resulting trade-offs with general knowledge capabilities. We introduce RefusEU, a novel refusal alignment dataset covering 12 European languages, including a dedicated test set for evaluating current state-of-the-art models. Our controlled Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) experiments provide two key insights: aligning models exclusively in English is insufficient to ensure cross-lingual safety, even for the same harm categories, whereas training on multilingual datasets can improve safety without degrading general performance, as measured by the Global MMLU benchmark.

</details>


### [176] [From Architecture to Output: Structural Origins of Hallucination in Large Language Models and the Amplifying Role of Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07537)
*Md. Rejaul Korim Sadi,Toufiqur Rahman Tasin,Golam Mostofa Naeem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了大语言模型幻觉产生的根本原因，指出其是自注意力机制、最大似然估计训练目标和自回归解码三个架构决策共同导致的复合故障系统，而非数据病理的独立结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉分类框架仅按输出类型（如内在/外在、忠实性/事实性）进行描述性分类，无法识别导致幻觉的具体内部机制。本文旨在从架构层面揭示幻觉的结构性成因。

Method: 系统分析三个核心架构决策——自注意力的共现学习、MLE训练目标的概率优化、自回归解码的从左到右承诺——如何各自产生特定类型的幻觉，并将其映射到现有分类学中的具体类别。

Result: 建立了机制-输出类型的映射关系：内在幻觉源于自注意力、外在幻觉源于MLE、逻辑不一致源于自回归解码；揭示了常见数据病理（长尾缺陷、训练偏差、合成污染）只是放大而非独立引发这些机制漏洞。

Conclusion: 输出类型分类具有诊断局限性，应转向推理层缓解方法；幻觉是架构设计的内在结构性产物，而非单纯的数据问题。

Abstract: Large language models hallucinate--producing fluent, confident, factually wrong outputs--with a consistency that persists across generations and scales. Existing taxonomies classify hallucination by output type, distinguishing intrinsic from extrinsic failures and faithfulness from factuality divergence. These frameworks are descriptively rigorous but do not identify which internal mechanism produced a given instance. This paper analyses hallucination as a structural consequence of three architectural decisions that together form a compound failure system. Self-attention's co-occurrence learning substitutes statistical proximity for semantic meaning and produces entity confusion, fact misattribution, and semantic drift. The maximum likelihood estimation training objective optimises next-token probability without factual constraint, rewarding statistically plausible outputs regardless of their truth value. Autoregressive decoding's permanent left-to-right commitment under exposure bias ensures that a single wrong token cascades forward through the entire output sequence without revision. Dataset pathologies--long-tail deficiencies, training bias, and synthetic pollution--amplify these vulnerabilities but do not independently cause them. We make three contributions. First, we map each mechanism to a specific output category in the Alansari and Luqman taxonomy, locating intrinsic hallucination in self-attention, extrinsic hallucination in MLE, and logical inconsistency in autoregressive decoding. Second, we show that each commonly cited dataset pathology exploits one of these mechanisms rather than originating hallucination independently. Third, we identify the diagnostic limitation of output-type-only classification and contrast it with inference-layer mitigation approaches.

</details>


### [177] [Finding Hidden Relationships Between Medical Concepts by Leveraging Metamap and Text Mining Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07540)
*Weikang Yang,S M Mazharul Hoque Chowdhury,Wei Jin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于MetaMap和文本挖掘的新模型，通过构建综合索引结构发现医学概念间的跨文档隐藏关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本数据中存在隐式关联，但现有方法忽略了跨文档的隐藏链接，因此需要新模型来发现医学概念间的潜在关系。

Method: 利用MetaMap和文本挖掘技术，构建新的综合索引结构，以发现跨文档中主题之间的隐藏链接。

Result: 实验表明该模型能有效发现主题间的新连接。

Conclusion: 该模型能够发现被大多数现有方法忽略的跨文档隐藏关联，在医学概念关系发现上具有有效性。

Abstract: Text is one of the most common ways to store data in this computerized world. At a glance, it may seem that those data are not interconnected. But in reality, data can have hidden connections. Therefore, in this research, a new model has been presented that can find hidden relationships between two medical concepts by using MetaMap and appropriate text-mining techniques. Specifically, the model creates a new comprehensive index structure and can find cross-document hidden links connecting topics of interest that most existing approaches have ignored. Experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed model in discovering new connections between topics.

</details>


### [178] [Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07547)
*Luoyuan Zhang,Bokai Xu,Junbo Cui,Weiyue Sun,Yingjing Xu,Hanyu Liu,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LWS（Listen-Write-Speak）三通道范式，让单一自回归LLM在共享因果注意力上下文中同时实现持续听用户语音、生成可见文本作为主要输出、并行实时口语回复，无需架构修改，仅通过Token Schema实现。在多项基准测试中表现优异，证明可见文本可作为语音交互的一等输出通道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语音的大语言模型局限于口语回复，无法输出代码、结构化分析、多步推理等文本原生能力，且将文本视为隐藏中间状态或次要模态，而非一等输出通道。

Method: 提出Listen-Write-Speak (LWS)文本优先三通道范式：单一自回归LLM在共享因果注意力上下文中连续听用户语音、生成可见自由文本作为主要输出、并行实时口语回复。通过Token Schema实现（无需架构修改），采用两阶段数据流水线合成每秒认知标注。

Result: Full-Duplex-Bench上表现强全双工交互，VoiceBench AlpacaEval达4.72分，写-说一致性达92.6%，在URO-Bench上持续优于内部消融版本。

Conclusion: 可见文本可作为语音交互的一等输出通道，且不影响实时响应性。

Abstract: Speech-based large language models are typically constrained to spoken replies, which limits their user-facing outputs to what can be verbalized and suppresses text-native capabilities such as code generation, structured analysis, and multi-step reasoning in realtime interaction, for tasks that require persistent, structured, and inspectable intermediate outputs. Existing work improves spoken reasoning or full-duplex turn-taking, but still treats text as a hidden intermediate state or a subordinate modality rather than a first-class output channel. We propose Listen-Write-Speak (LWS), a text-first tri-channel paradigm in which a single autoregressive LLM continuously listens to user audio, writes visible free-form text as its primary output, and speaks a realtime oral response in parallel under a shared causal attention context. This behavior is implemented entirely through a Token Schema, requiring no architectural modifications, and learned via a two-stage data pipeline that synthesizes per-second cognitive annotations consistent with the revealed input timeline. Empirically, LWS demonstrates strong full-duplex interaction on Full-Duplex-Bench, reaches 4.72 on VoiceBench AlpacaEval, achieves 92.6% writing-speaking consistency, and consistently outperforms its internal ablations on URO-Bench. These results suggest that visible writing can serve as a first-class output channel for speech interaction without sacrificing realtime responsiveness. The code and dataset are available on the project page: https://royalzhang.com/project/lws-page/.

</details>


### [179] [Priors Persist Through Suppression: A Stroop Paradigm for Lexical Override](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07555)
*Han-yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过Stroop范式实验发现，语言模型在遵循词汇重定义规则时，词汇先验并非被替换而是持续存在并产生干扰；通过激活修补技术定位了负责绑定操作的源位置三元组（定义主体、定义目标、查询词），并通过解离实验证明目标保留是绑定操作的特异性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究语言模型在词汇重定义（如"doctor"意为"forest"）场景下，词汇先验（lexical prior）是否会被覆盖替代，以及如何与局部规则共存并产生干扰效应。

Method: 采用Stroop范式设计重定义规则与词汇先验的冲突实验，使用11个开源模型（1B-9B参数），结合激活修补（activation patching）、定义目标交换（definition-target swap）和解离实验（dissociation experiments）进行机制分析。

Result: 词汇先验强度可预测干扰效应，即使控制答案先验、频率、分词和提示措辞后仍显著；定位到源位置三元组可近乎完全恢复冲突效应（聚合R值0.92-1.06）；解离实验表明目标抑制在多种条件下均发生，而目标logit崩塌仅当定义目标位置被破坏时出现。

Conclusion: 词汇先验在重定义过程中并非被替换，而是通过持续性干扰与局部规则共存；行为和机制分析一致表明词汇先验既是干扰的来源，也是重写操作留下痕迹的位置。

Abstract: Glossaries, technical specifications, and system prompts routinely ask language models to use familiar words in unfamiliar ways. When this works, the lexical prior persists through override rather than being replaced: it continues to operate after the local rule applies, with the rule lowering its logit rather than installing the new meaning on top. We test this with a Stroop-style paradigm: a remapping rule ("doctor" means "forest") pitted against the query word's lexical-prior distractor ("hospital"), with matched neutral controls. Across 11 open-weight models spanning four families and 1B--9B parameters, lexical-prior strength predicts interference even after item-level controls for answer prior, frequency, tokenization, and prompt wording. Activation patching on five aligned models locates a source-position triplet (definition subject, definition target, query word) that nearly fully recovers the conflict effect (aggregate $R \in [0.92, 1.06]$). A definition-target swap shows the triplet performs binding rather than identity matching. Dissociation experiments isolate target preservation as the binding-specific signature: distractor suppression occurs under matched, swap, and item-mismatched conditions alike, whereas target logit collapse occurs only when the definition-target position is corrupted. Behavior and mechanism converge on the same channel: the lexical prior is where both interference originates and where override leaves its mark.

</details>


### [180] [Phantom transitions in language model fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07559)
*Vaibhav Prakash,Jayasri Dontabhaktuni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了语言模型在近义词竞争上下文微调时的静默失败现象，发现损失下降但正确token排名不提升。通过序参量分解，识别出运动失败和结构失败两种模式，并排除了相变解释，证明不连续性仅存在于softmax读出层。框架可跨架构预测临界学习率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究语言模型在近义词竞争上下文中微调时出现的静默失败现象，即交叉熵损失单调下降但正确token从未在排名上超越竞争对手。

Method: 采用序参量（order parameter）结合预测分布和成对嵌入重叠，将其分解为信号（跟踪模型对正确token的承诺）和背景阻力（嵌入批量泄漏概率）。在5种Transformer架构、10个近义词上下文上实验，包括全微调和LoRA微调。

Result: 识别出两种失败模式：运动失败（信号保持较小）和结构失败（阻力随微调恶化）。观察到类似弹射的跳跃但排除了相变解释。少量无量纲量组织跨架构轨迹。盲测中框架预测保留架构的临界学习率误差仅2.1%。

Conclusion: 弹射跳跃是假象，不连续性仅存在于softmax读出层，并非几何相变。发现仅限于近义词机制，不应外推。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model on contexts whose correct completion has a near-synonym competitor often fails silently. The cross-entropy loss decreases monotonically while the correct token never overtakes the competitor in rank. We study this regime across five transformer architectures spanning two families and a fivefold parameter range, on ten hand-selected near-synonym contexts. We instrument these failures with an order parameter combining the predicted distribution and pairwise embedding overlaps. It decomposes additively into a signal, tracking the model's commitment to the correct token over its nearest competitor, and a background drag, set by how the embedding bulk leaks probability into the score. This isolates two failure modes. In kinematic failure the signal stays small. In structural failure the drag actively worsens as fine-tuning proceeds. We observe sharp catapult-like jumps in the order parameter that resemble a phase transition. A central negative result organises the paper. The transitions are phantoms. The spontaneous-symmetry-breaking interpretation is ruled out by direct measurement. Catapult-like jumps still appear under LoRA fine-tuning with the token embedding matrix exactly unchanged during training, where no geometric phase transition is possible. The discontinuity lives entirely in the softmax readout. A small number of dimensionless quantities organise the trajectory across architectures. One is consistent across all five under full fine-tuning. A second sorts architectures into two classes by bulk embedding distribution and predicts LoRA sufficiency. As a blind test, the framework predicts the critical learning rate of a held-out architecture, not used to fit any parameter, to within 2.1% of a subsequent learning-rate sweep. Findings concern the near-synonym mechanism only and should not be extrapolated without recalibration.

</details>


### [181] [Function-Vector Heads Are Two Populations: Writers and Cancellers in In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07560)
*Han-yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现函数向量（FV）头并非同质功能类，而是分为“写入者”（推高规则正确logit）和“取消者”（压低规则正确logit）两个对立子群体。基于符号保持的排序标准（精化DLA+排列FDR）和路径修补验证，在3个模型家族、6个Pythia规模下验证了四条件规范判决。零消融取消者在6/6主细胞中带来+0.13至+0.29 nats的logit增益和+2至+7个百分点的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的函数向量头识别方法仅依赖因果贡献幅度排序，隐含假设顶部集合是同质功能类，但该假设已被证伪。作者旨在揭示FV头群体的真实异质性结构。

Method: 提出符号保持的排序标准（精化DLA+排列FDR控制），结合路径修补验证每个候选。将FV头分为写入者和取消者两类，并通过零消融实验验证取消者的作用。

Result: 在3个模型家族和6个Pythia规模下，13/15的细胞验证了四条件规范判决；5/6主细胞中符号打乱拒绝同质性假设。Todd的top-20方法在层级任务中捕捉了64%取消者但仅4%写入者；在模块任务中则相反。零消融取消者在6/6主细胞中带来一致的logit增益和准确率提升。

Conclusion: 函数向量头包含功能对立的子群体，仅靠幅度排序无法捕捉这种结构。取消者子群体在模型行为中发挥实质性抑制作用，排除六种人为解释后其作用仍成立。

Abstract: Function-vector (FV) heads (Todd et al., 2024) are typically identified by the magnitude of their causal contribution to in-context rule tasks, under the implicit assumption that the top set is a homogeneous functional class. This assumption fails. We replace magnitude-only ranking with a sign-preserving criterion (refined DLA + permutation FDR) and validate each candidate by path patching. The FV head population then splits into two opposing sub-populations: writers push the rule-correct logit up; cancellers push it down. A four-condition canonical verdict holds in $13/15$ cells across three model families and six Pythia scales, and a sign-shuffle rejects homogeneity in $5/6$ main cells. The structure is invisible to magnitude-only ranking: Todd's top-$20$ captures $64\%$ of cancellers but only $4\%$ of writers on the hierarchical task, and $59\%$ of writers but only $8\%$ of cancellers on the modular task. We rule out six artefact accounts on all $27$ canceller (cell, head) pairs: induction overlap, sinks, generic importance, rank-$1$ copy-suppression, V-cascade, and rank-nearest non-FV controls. Zero-ablating cancellers yields $+0.13$ to $+0.29$ nats of logit gain in $6/6$ main cells with a directionally consistent $+2$ to $+7$ pp accuracy effect.

</details>


### [182] [Subtitle-Aligned Fine-Tuning of Whisper for Swiss German ASR: Benchmark Contamination, Convention Mismatch, and an Honest Baseline at 25.6% WER (13.8% cWER)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07608)
*Felix Akeret*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了使用1367小时广播语音及标准德语字幕弱监督微调Whisper large-v3用于瑞士德语ASR，通过16次迭代训练比较LoRA与全参数微调，发现基准测试存在严重污染（零瑞士德语数据的模型WER仅13.88%），并发布两款公开可用的模型（LoRA: 25.32% WER/13.9% cWER；全微调: 25.60% WER/13.8% cWER）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有瑞士德语ASR性能评估被基准测试污染严重高估，缺乏诚实评估和公开可用的模型，亟需系统性研究微调策略、幻觉根因及数据质量影响。

Method: 使用1367小时广播语音+标准德语字幕弱监督，在NVIDIA DGX Spark上进行16次迭代训练，比较LoRA与全微调；分析幻觉根因，量化数据质量、字幕对齐和训练策略的影响；通过内容WER（cWER）分离真实错误与风格变异，并进行偏差校正估计。

Result: 最佳模型实测WER 25.6%，cWER 13.8%，偏差校正后降至8.5%；发现基准污染：零瑞士德语数据的Whisper模型WER 13.88%，Phi-4-multimodal仅3.9% WER；LoRA适配器25.32% WER/13.9% cWER，全微调25.60% WER/13.8% cWER。

Conclusion: 基准测试主要衡量惯例匹配而非方言理解；公开模型在Apache 2.0下发布，无需机构数据协议，确保可复现性。

Abstract: We present a systematic study of fine-tuning OpenAI's Whisper large-v3 for Swiss German ASR, using 1,367 hours of broadcast speech paired with Standard German subtitles as weak supervision. Through 16 iterative training runs on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (Grace Blackwell, 128 GB unified memory, up to 1 PFLOP FP4), we compare LoRA and full fine-tuning of the 1.55B-parameter model, investigate hallucination root causes, and quantify the effect of data quality, subtitle alignment, and training strategy. Our best model achieves 25.6% measured WER on the All Swiss German Dialects Test Set (ASGDTS) in an honest evaluation on strictly disjoint data. A harmonized error analysis separating genuine errors from valid stylistic variation (tense, word order, Swiss orthography) yields a content WER (cWER) of 13.8%, counting only actual recognition failures. Bias-corrected estimation reduces this to 8.5%, suggesting the true error rate is roughly one third of measured WER.
  We demonstrate that published state-of-the-art Swiss German ASR results (17.1-17.5% WER) are inflated by benchmark contamination: a vanilla Whisper model self-trained on the ASGDTS test set with zero Swiss German data achieves 13.88% WER, surpassing all published systems. Experiments with Phi-4-multimodal show an even stronger memorization effect (3.9% WER), revealing that the benchmark primarily measures convention matching rather than dialectal comprehension.
  We release two models, a LoRA adapter (25.32% WER, 13.9% cWER) and a full fine-tuned model (25.60% WER, 13.8% cWER), among the few publicly available, honestly evaluated Whisper models for Swiss German, under Apache 2.0 with full reproducibility, requiring no institutional data agreements.

</details>


### [183] [ReadingMachine: A Computational Methodology for Structured Corpus Reading and Large-Scale Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07753)
*James Morrissey*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReadingMachine是一种基于大语言模型的结构化语料库阅读方法，通过可审查的分阶段分析（洞察提取、语义聚类、主题生成、迭代遗漏检测）对大规模文档集合进行有界读取，在152份产业政策文档上提取了17,500余条洞察并生成结构化主题图谱，已作为开源框架发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大规模语料分析方法（如检索增强或递归摘要）存在不可逆压缩、可追溯性差、无法保留语料内部分歧等局限，亟需一种兼顾覆盖度、可追溯性和分歧保留的结构化分析方法。

Method: 将分析分解为可审查的阶段性操作：洞察提取（Insight Extraction）、语义聚类（Semantic Clustering）、主题生成（Theme Generation）和迭代遗漏检测（Iterative Omission Detection），延迟不可逆压缩并显式跟踪中间表示。

Result: 在包含152份产业政策文档的异构语料库上完成实证，提取超过17,500条洞察并生成结构化主题图谱。

Conclusion: ReadingMachine作为一种开放源码的实验框架，为大规模定性综合和语料库分析提供了有效方案，在覆盖度、可追溯性和分歧保留方面优于传统方法。

Abstract: ReadingMachine is a computational methodology for structured corpus reading that uses large language models to perform bounded reading operations over entire document collections. Rather than relying on retrieval or recursive summarization, the approach decomposes analysis into inspectable stages including insight extraction, semantic clustering, theme generation, and iterative omission detection. By delaying irreversible compression and explicitly tracking intermediate representations, the method prioritizes coverage, traceability, and preservation of disagreement across large corpora. The system is demonstrated on a heterogeneous corpus of 152 industrial policy documents, producing more than 17,500 extracted insights and a structured thematic map. ReadingMachine is released as an open-source experimental framework for large-scale qualitative synthesis and corpus analysis.

</details>


### [184] [Unlocking Latent Value: Taxonomy-Guided Recovery of High-Performing Data from Low-Tier Web Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07778)
*Neeraj Varshney,Sanket Lokegaonkar,Nasser Zalmout,Qingyu Yin,Priyanka Nigam,Bing Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于多维分类体系的网页数据过滤框架，通过时间性、文化特异性等新维度对预训练数据进行筛选，在计算效率可控的前提下，从被降级处理的网页数据中提取出高质量内容，在推理、编程等基准上显著超越未过滤的高质量数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网页数据管线将文档质量压缩为单一复合分数，系统性地遗漏了评分者权重不足维度上的高价值内容。作者旨在通过多维分类体系恢复这些被忽略的价值。

Method: (1) 基于ESSENTIAL-WEB分类体系引入时间性和文化特异性两个新维度；利用Qwen2.5 32B标注1400万文档并蒸馏至0.5B模型；训练73M多任务MLP用于E5嵌入，实现50倍推理吞吐。(2) 提出两通道过滤框架：Pass 1在小规模上识别最强维度信号；Pass 2从顶级信号构建析取/合取复合过滤器，以极小代价识别高性能配置。

Result: 中档数据上，最佳过滤器在推理、编程和知识基准上分别超越未过滤基线12.1%、9.5%和2.0%，甚至超过未过滤的高质量数据6.7%（推理）和13.7%（编程）。低于典型生产阈值两档的数据经过滤后，推理和编程提升22.3%和19.5%，在编程上超越顶级数据。

Conclusion: 大量潜在价值仍锁定在被降级的网页数据中，多维分类过滤是一种原则性强、计算高效的解锁方法。

Abstract: Dominant web data curation pipelines for pretraining collapse document quality into a single composite score, systematically missing high-value content along dimensions the scorer underweights. We present a taxonomy-driven framework that recovers this value by filtering along semantically meaningful dimensions that composite scores fail to capture. First, building on the ESSENTIAL-WEB taxonomy, we introduce two novel dimensions: timeliness and cultural specificity, both of which show low pairwise NMI with existing ones. We annotate 14M documents using Qwen2.5 32B and distill into a lightweight 0.5B model. To enable rapid corpus-wide annotation, we additionally train a 73M multi-task MLP on E5 embeddings, achieving 50x inference throughput. Second, to navigate the combinatorial explosion of filter configurations, we introduce a compute-efficient two-pass framework: Pass 1 identifies the strongest dimension signals at small scale; Pass 2 constructs and evaluates conjunctive and disjunctive compound filters from the top performers - identifying high-performing configurations at a fraction of full scaling-law cost. Applying the selected filters to deprioritized web data, taxonomy-filtered subsets outperform their unfiltered baselines and even surpass the highest-quality tier. On mid-tier data, our best filter improves over its unfiltered baseline by 12.1% on reasoning, 9.5% on coding, and 2.0% on knowledge benchmarks, exceeding unfiltered top-tier data by 6.7% on reasoning and 13.7% on coding. Furthermore, filtered data from two tiers below the typical production threshold improves by 22.3% on reasoning and 19.5% on coding over its unfiltered baseline, surpassing top-tier data on coding benchmarks. These results establish that vast latent value remains locked in deprioritized web data, and that multi-dimensional taxonomy filtering is a principled, compute-efficient key to unlocking it.

</details>


### [185] [Evaluating RAG Reliability under Clean, Misleading, and Mixed Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07783)
*Sevgi Yigit-Sert*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种评估协议，系统性地测试RAG系统在参数化知识与误导性检索证据冲突时的鲁棒性，通过干净、投毒和混合证据场景，结合参数覆盖率和置信度指标分析误导信息对生成过程的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 misinformation 丰富的环境中，检索到的内容可能包含看似合理但错误的信息，这引发了关于RAG系统可靠性的担忧。现有研究缺乏系统性的方法来评估RAG系统面对参数化知识与误导性检索证据冲突时的表现。

Method: 提出评估协议：针对模型在无检索时能正确回答的事实性问题，构造干净、投毒和混合三种证据场景；采用参数覆盖率和置信度指标，分析误导信息如何影响LLM的生成过程。

Result: 通过系统性测试，揭示RAG系统在信息混乱场景下的鲁棒性表现，量化误导信息对参数化知识覆盖和模型置信度的影响。

Conclusion: 该研究为理解和改进RAG系统在面对误导性检索信息时的可靠性提供了分析框架和评估方法论。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to improve the factual reliability of large language models (LLMs) by grounding answers in retrieved evidence. In misinformation-rich environments, however, retrieved content may include plausible but incorrect information, raising concerns about the reliability of RAG-based information access systems. In this work, we propose an evaluation protocol to systematically test how the RAG system handles conflicts between parametric knowledge and evidence retrieved from context with varying amounts of misleading information. We target correct answers to factoid questions that the model responds to correctly, even when there is no retrieval, and use this to test the system with clean, poisoned, and mixed evidence. The proposed analytical framework combines parametric override and confidence metrics to assess when and how misleading information affects the generation process of LLMs. This study aims to provide insights into the robustness of RAG systems in information disorder scenarios.

</details>


### [186] [SLMJury: Can Small Language Models Judge as Well as Large Ones?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07810)
*Anish Laddha,Nitesh Pradhan,Gaurav Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SLMJury 系统评估了16个小型语言模型（0.6B-14B参数）作为评判者的表现，发现：过度思考效应具有领域依赖性；领域泛化能力因模型家族而异；闭端与开端评判依赖不同能力；多智能体辩论会降低准确率。小型模型可作为可靠且低成本的自动评估替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型用作评判者时存在成本高、延迟大、不透明等可扩展性限制，亟需探索更轻量、高效的替代方案。

Method: 提出SLMJury框架，将评判形式化为预算条件函数，在8个闭端任务（数学、科学、通用推理，N=64,824）和2个开端任务（SummEval、MT-Bench）上，从5个维度系统评估16个SLM（4个模型家族，0.6B-14B参数）。

Result: (1) 数学领域10-token快速判断优于长推理2-7%，而通用任务上推理可提升高达23%；(2) 数学到通用任务的准确率差距从不到10%到近40%；(3) 最佳闭端评判者Phi-4在MT-Bench上降至第9名，而推理模型表现相反；(4) 多智能体辩论降低所有配置的准确率，但最佳评判者对6种对抗性人格的方差≤0.55%。

Conclusion: 可靠的自动评估不需要大型专有模型，但没有单一SLM在所有场景中占优，选择评判者需根据任务特性进行。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as judges for evaluating model outputs, but their high cost, latency, and opacity limit scalability. We introduce SLMJury, a framework for evaluating small language models (SLMs) as judges across two paradigms: closed-ended binary correctness and open-ended quality scoring.
